Researchers found both water and carbon dioxide ice.

news.title: With Starship catch, SpaceX still shows it can dazzle the world
paras: A satisfying ending SpaceX returned its Starship rocket on Saturday—but there’s a catch It felt like stepping into the future. SpaceX's Starship descends towards the mechanical tower catch at Starbase, Texas on November 14, 2026.

Incongruously, the rocket flew horizontal until the last moment when three Raptor rocket engines ignited and it swooped into a vertical position. Slowly, gently, haltingly, the Starship upper stage eased its way toward the waiting tower where two arms extended outward, awaiting expectantly. Two nubs on either side of the rocket, each protruding only about one foot, were the only purchase the rocket would have on the arms.

news.title: Winemakers are learning that conservation can be good for business
paras: Wine and roses Winemakers are learning that conservation can be good for business Healthy soils, native plants, and fewer chemicals are helping vineyards adapt. This vineyard, seen through an electric fence, relies on cover crops in South Africa’s Western Cape region.

The region produces about 90 percent of South Africa’s wine , but winemakers there are increasingly struggling with drought, excessive heat and erratic rainfall. Temperatures in the region have risen 1.5 to 2 times faster than the global average over the past five decades. And extreme storms have become more intense as climate variability increases.

news.title: This Week In Space podcast: Episode 236 — Alienspotting
paras: When we think of extraterrestrials, our minds generally go from the latex-suited bipedal aliens seen in Star Trek and Star Wars to more exotic critters in sci-fi movies. Scientists think in terms of carbon-based microbial life and other lower life forms.

But some researchers, such as Tikhonov from Washington University, suggest that life can take more unusual forms, ones we might not even recognize. He further suggests a new definition of life: something that takes in and transforms energy and replicates. His ideas radically expand our notions of alien life and how it might be recognized.

paras: 14), a landmark achievement that could unlock the giant vehicle's immense potential. Starship launched on its 15th test flight on Friday evening (Nov. 13), rising into the sky from SpaceX's Starbase site in South Texas.

The mission plan called for bringing both of the vehicle's stages back to Starbase and catching them with the launch tower's "chopstick" arms — an unprecedented total recovery of an orbital rocket . That didn't happen; Starship's Super Heavy booster diverted to a Gulf of Mexico splashdown on Friday after experiencing a low-fuel alarm. But Ship succeeded in its attempt, notching a huge milestone for SpaceX and its dream of full rocket reuse.

sport.title: November 15, 1981: The day Jimmy Connors and John McEnroe misbehaved at Wembley
paras: On this day in 1981, two fierce rivals from the same nation clashed in more ways than one at the Wembley Grand Prix Jimmy Connors, born in 1952, was one of the greatest tennis players of his time.

Coached by his mother Gloria, Connors was one of the first few players to hit the ball flat and predominantly from the baseline. Hitting the ball on the rise, his game would be very influential for future generations of tennis players. “Jimbo” turned pro in 1972 and became world No 1 by 1974.

sport.title: Taylor Fritz says who he finds more difficult to face out of Carlos Alcaraz and Jannik Sinner
paras: Taylor Fritz is a player who has been thwarted more than most by the generational talents of Carlos Alcaraz and Jannik Sinner, having played them both a combined 13 times. He has been knocked out of Grand Slams, Masters 1000s and the ATP Finals by them, mercilessly stopped from achieving his ultimate ambitions.

And yet, he continues plugging away, desperate to do all he can to maximise his already impressive career. He and the rest of his generation deserve great credit for remaining so dedicated, having transitioned from the Big Three’s dominance to this new Carlos Alcaraz and Jannik Sinner takeover.
